gaps.sentence: Heavy snow ___ the mountain passes for days.
gaps.explanation: 'Block a road/pass' = make it impassable; 'clog' is for pipes/filters.
deny + -ing: denied doing (also denied having done).

gaps.sentence: The new law ___ companies from selling user data.
gaps.explanation: 'Prevent somebody from doing' = stop them doing it; the other verbs do not fit the pattern.

gaps.sentence: The committee ___ to delay the vote until May.
gaps.explanation: 'Agree to do' = consent; 'accept' takes an object (accept the plan), not to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: The task turned out to be far more ___ than expected.
gaps.explanation: 'Demanding' (adjective) = requiring a lot of effort or attention.

gaps.sentence: The play was a complete ___ — nobody came.
The meeting is ___ to last two hours.
gaps.explanation: 'Be expected to' = people think it will; 'wait' is not used this way in the passive.

gaps.sentence: The two accounts of the event ___ sharply.
